sanskrit: tvaṁ tyam iṭato ratham indra prāvaḥ sutāvataḥ | aśṛṇoḥ somino havam ||
english: You, O Indra, saved that chariot of the one who pressed Soma, the one who had been forced away; you heard the call of the Soma-presser.

sanskrit: tvam makhasya dodha taḥ śiro 'va tvaco bharaḥ | agacchaḥ somino gṛham ||
english: You cut off the head of Makha who was shaking violently, you stripped him of his skin; you went to the house of the Soma-presser.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tyam indra martyam āstrabudhnāya venyam | muhuḥ śrathnā manasyave ||
english: You, O Indra, repeatedly loosen that mortal man, Vena, beloved, from the one who has an arrow-shaft at his base, for the one who is eager in mind.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tyam indra sūryam paścā santam puras kṛdhi | devānāṁ cit tiro vaśam ||
english: You, O Indra, caused that sun, which was behind, to come to the fore, even against the will of the gods.

sanskrit: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṁ yad ūdhabhiḥ ||
english: Come hither together with the forest; the cows follow the track with their udders.

sanskrit: ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṁhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ ||
english: Come hither with a treasure-bringing thought, O most munificent one who kindles Makha, with thy bountiful gifts.

sanskrit: pitubhṛto na tantum it sudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi ||
english: Like those sustained by nourishment, we who are bountiful set on the thread; we worship.

sanskrit: uṣā apas svasus tamaḥ saṁ vartayati vartaniṁ sujātatā ||
english: Uṣas rolls away the darkness of her sister, she rolls the track well by her noble birth.

sanskrit: ā tvāhārṣam antar edhi dhruvas tiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ | viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvad rāṣṭram adhi bhraśat ||
english: I have brought thee hither; abide among us, stand firm, unmoved and unshaken. May all the peoples desire thee; may the kingdom not fall away from thee.

sanskrit: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ | indra iha dhruvas tiṣṭha iha rāṣṭram u dhāraya ||
english: Be here, do not depart; stand firm here, unmoved like a mountain. Stand firm here like Indra; hold fast the kingdom here.

sanskrit: imam indro adīdharad dhruvaṁ dhruveṇa haviṣā | tasmai somo adhi bravat tasmā u brahmaṇas patiḥ ||
english: Indra has made him firm with the firm oblation; Soma has spoken for him, and for him the Lord of Prayer has spoken.

sanskrit: dhruvā dyaur dhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime | dhruvaṁ viśvam idaṁ jagad dhruvo rājā viśām ayam ||
english: Firm is the sky, firm is the earth, firm are these mountains; firm is all this world; firm is this king of the peoples.

sanskrit: dhruvaṁ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṁ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | dhruvaṁ ta indraś cāgniś ca rāṣṭraṁ dhārayatāṁ dhruvam ||
english: May King Varuṇa make thee firm, firm the god Bṛhaspati; may Indra and Agni hold firm thy firm kingship.

sanskrit: dhruvaṁ dhruveṇa haviṣābhi somam mṛśāmasi | atho ta indraḥ kevalīr viśo balihṛtas karat ||
english: With the firm oblation we touch Soma to make him firm; moreover, may Indra make the peoples, all of them, tribute-bearers to thee.

sanskrit: abhīvartena haviṣā yenendro abhivāvṛte | tenāsmān brahmaṇas pate 'bhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya ||
english: With the all-surrounding oblation with which Indra compassed all about, with that, O Lord of Prayer, turn us round for kingship.

sanskrit: abhivṛtya sapatnān abhi yā no arātayaḥ | abhi pṛtanyantaṁ tiṣṭhābhi yo na irasyati ||
english: Surpassing the rivals, surpassing those who are our enemies, stand thou over the one who fights against us, over him who hates us.

sanskrit: abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo avīvṛtat | abhi tvā viśvā bhūtāny abhīvarto yathāsasi ||
english: God Savitṛ has encompassed thee round about, Soma has encompassed thee; all beings have encompassed thee so that thou art the all-surrounding one.

sanskrit: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvy abhavad dyumny uttamaḥ | idaṁ tad akri devā asapatnaḥ kilābhuvam ||
english: By which oblation Indra, having acted, became most glorious — with this the gods have wrought it: I have indeed become one without a rival.

sanskrit: asapatnaḥ sapatnahābhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ | yathāham eṣām bhūtānāṁ virājāni janasya ca ||
english: Without rivals, a slayer of rivals, all-encompassing, overpowering adversaries — so that I may rule over all these beings and over the people.

sanskrit: pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā | dhūrṣu yujyadhvaṁ sunuta ||
english: May god Savitṛ impel you forward, O pressing stones, according to the ordinance; be yoked in the shafts, press out the Soma.

sanskrit: grāvāṇo apa ducchunām apa sedhata durmatim | usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam ||
english: O pressing stones, drive away ill-omen, drive away evil intent; you who are like the rays of dawn, make healing.

sanskrit: grāvāṇa upareṣv ā mahīyante sajoṣasaḥ | vṛṣṇe dadhato vṛṣṇyam ||
english: The pressing stones, setting about the upper ones in unison, glorify themselves; they bestow on the bull his virile power.

sanskrit: grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā | yajamānāya sunvate ||
english: May god Savitṛ now impel you, O pressing stones, according to the ordinance — for the sacrificer who presses.

sanskrit: pra sūnava ṛbhūṇām bṛhan navanta vṛjanā | kṣāmā ye viśvadhāyaso 'śnan dhenum na mātaram ||
english: Loudly the sons of the Ṛbhus shout forth; the settlements exult, they who are all-sustaining on the earth, who have drunk from the cow as from a mother.

sanskrit: pra devaṁ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam | havyā no vakṣad ānuṣak ||
english: With a divine thought bring forward the god Jātavedas; may he carry our offerings in unbroken succession.

sanskrit: ayam u ṣya pra devayur hotā yajñāya nīyate | ratho na yor abhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāñ cetati tmanā ||
english: This one here who is pious, the Hotṛ, is led forth for the sacrifice; like a well-harnessed chariot he who is full of warmth moves by his own impulse.

sanskrit: ayam agnir uruṣyaty amṛtād iva janmanaḥ | sahasaś cit sahīyān devo jīvātave kṛtaḥ ||
english: This Agni rescues as if from immortality at birth; stronger even than strength, the god is made for the sake of life.

sanskrit: pataṁgam aktam asurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ | samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnām padam icchanti vedhāsaḥ ||
english: The wise ones behold with heart and mind the bird anointed by the Asura's magic power; the seers discern him within the ocean, and the inspired ones seek the track of the rays.

sanskrit: pataṁgo vācam manasā bibharti tāṁ gandharvo 'vadad garbhe antaḥ | tāṁ dyotamānāṁ svaryam manīṣām ṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti ||
english: The bird carries Speech in his mind; the Gandharva uttered it within the womb. The seers guard that shining, heavenly wisdom at the station of the Ṛta.

sanskrit: apaśyaṁ gopām anipadyamānam ā ca parā ca pathibhiś carantam | sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīr vasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣv antaḥ ||
english: I saw the Herdsman who never alights, going hither and thither on his paths; clothed in garments that converge and that go in all directions, he moves round and round within the worlds.

sanskrit: tyam ū ṣu vājinaṁ devajūtaṁ sahāvānaṁ tarutāraṁ rathānām | ariṣṭanemim pṛtanājam āśuṁ svastaye tārkṣyam ihā huvema ||
english: Let us invoke here for our well-being that prize-horse Tārkṣya, spurred by the gods, victorious in battles, conqueror of chariots, with unbroken felloes, a champion in battles, swift.

sanskrit: indrasye va rātim ājohu vānāḥ svastaye nāvam ivā ruhema | urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vām etau mā paretau riṣāma ||
english: Calling aloud for Indra's gift of bounty, let us mount him for our well-being as a boat; on the wide, broad, deep expanse — may we not be harmed in our going, nor in our return.

sanskrit: sadyaś cid yaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpas tatāna | sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṁhir na smā varante yuvatim na śaryām ||
english: He who at once with his might spread the five peoples like the sun with light — his speed that wins thousands, that wins hundreds, does not withdraw from a young woman or an arrow.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgam ṛtviyam | yadi śrāto juhota na yady aśrāto mamattana ||
english: Rise up, both of you, look upon Indra's seasonable share; if it is cooked, pour the libation; if uncooked, be ye gladdened.

sanskrit: śrātaṁ havir o ṣv indra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam | pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṁ carantam ||
english: The oblation is cooked — come forth, O Indra; the sun has gone to the mid-point of the path. Thy companions sit around thee with treasures, as herd-keepers around a leader of the troop as he goes.

sanskrit: śrātam manya ūdhani śrātam agnau suśrātam manye tad ṛtaṁ navīyaḥ | mādhyaṁdinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrin purukṛj juṣāṇaḥ ||
english: I deem it cooked in the udder, cooked in the fire; I deem that truth the newest and best. Drink, O Indra wielder of the vajra, much-doing, enjoying gladly the curds of the midday pressing.

sanskrit: pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūñ jyeṣṭhas te śuṣma iha rātir astu | indrā bhara dakṣiṇenā vasūni patiḥ sindhūnām asi revatīnām ||
english: Thou hast overcome the enemies, O Much-invoked; may thy might be supreme, thy generosity here. O Indra, bring wealth with thy right hand; thou art lord of the rich rivers.

sanskrit: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ | sṛkaṁ saṁśāya pavim indra tigmaṁ vi śatrūn tāḻhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
english: Like a fearsome beast that roams the mountains, thou hast come hither from the far-off distance beyond. Sharpening thy sharp blade and bolt, O Indra, strike the enemies asunder, thrust aside the battles.

sanskrit: indra kṣatram abhi vāmam ojo 'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām | apānudo janam amitrayantam uruṁ devebhyo akṛṇor u lokam ||
english: O Indra, thou wast born with might and lordly power, O bull of the tribes; thou didst thrust away the people who acted as enemies, and madest a wide space for the gods.
